name: Chatbot Arena
intro: Chatbot Arena 是实时众包的匿名模型对战平台：用户向两个隐藏身份的模型提交同一段多轮对话并投票，系统经过内容与异常行为过滤后，用成对偏好统计生成公开排行榜。
build_method: 实时匿名双模型对战, 众包成对偏好投票, 内容与异常用户过滤, 自适应采样
metric: Bradley–Terry score, win rate, confidence interval
task_type: 开放式对话, 偏好评测
eval_feature: 实时开放问题, 多轮对话, 人工偏好, 匿名模型对, 专家一致性验证
scale: 论文快照超过240,000张选票, 600个主题簇
build_method_en: Live Anonymous Pairwise Battles, Crowdsourced Preference Votes, Content and Anomalous-user Filtering, Adaptive Pair Sampling
eval_feature_en: Live Open-ended Prompts, Multi-turn Dialogue, Human Preference, Anonymous Model Pairs, Expert-agreement Validation
intro_en: Chatbot Arena is a live crowdsourced platform for anonymous model battles. Users send the same multi-turn conversation to two identity-hidden models and vote; filtered pairwise preferences are then converted into a public ranking.
scale_en: More than 240,000 votes in the paper snapshot, 600 topic clusters
metric_en: Bradley–Terry Score, Win Rate, Confidence Interval
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2403.04132, Sections 3-7. Users accept terms that permit public data release, submit live prompts to an anonymous model pair, may continue multi-turn dialogue until they can decide, and vote for model A, model B, tie, or both are bad. Each record contains both conversations and the vote. Pair sampling is non-uniform and increasingly favors similarly performing models to improve sample efficiency. The pipeline filters prompts containing model or company identity terms, flags unsafe requests, and detects anomalous users with repetitive, meaningless, or strategic behavior. The paper snapshot contains more than 240,000 votes. Validation clusters prompts into 600 diverse long-tail topics and blindly re-labels 160 battles with graduate-student experts, observing 72-to-83-percent crowd-expert agreement. Ranking estimates the pairwise win matrix, fits reweighted Bradley–Terry coefficients using inverse pair-sampling probabilities, uses sandwich covariance and confidence intervals, and publishes the resulting approximate rank and win rates.
